properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: evp_bytestokey@1.0.3 (entry l.6497): the OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey single-iteration MD5 KDF re-implemented in JS, part of the browserify crypto shim. Required by browserify-aes@1.2.0 (l.3806), browserify-cipher@1.0.1 (l.3818) and parse-asn1@5.1.6 (l.12386); the shim root crypto-browserify@3.12.0 is required by web3-eth-accounts@1.2.11 (l.20671), so this KDF ships inside the web3 browser bundle of this app. Changeable here by upgrading the web3/crypto-browserify stack; no first-party call site exerc

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: bcrypt-pbkdf@1.0.2 (entry l.3631): bcrypt_pbkdf, the OpenSSH private-key passphrase KDF (not the bcrypt password hash). Required by sshpk@1.16.1 (l.19008) in the http-signature/SSH-key-parsing stack that react-scripts 2.1.3 dev tooling pulls in; itself requires tweetnacl (l.3636). Dev tooling only — not shipped in the app bundle. Changeable here by upgrading react-scripts.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge@0.9.0 (entry l.11927) provides RSA key generation for self-signed HTTPS dev certificates. In the tree solely via selfsigned@1.10.7 (l.18463) <- webpack-dev-server (l.21185) <- react-scripts@2.1.3. Dev-server-only; quantum-vulnerable RSA but no production exposure and no first-party call site (keys are generated at dev time and discarded). Changeable by upgrading react-scripts.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: create-ecdh@4.0.4 (entry l.4772, requires elliptic ^6.5.3) — required by crypto-browserify@3.12.0 (l.4841), which is itself required by web3-eth-accounts@1.2.11 (l.20671) and by node-libs-browser/webpack. ECDH-capable code ships inside the web3 browser bundle this app imports, though no code path performs key agreement (MetaMask holds keys). Changeable by upgrading web3/crypto-browserify.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 (entry l.19855) supplies Ed25519 signing inside sshpk@1.16.1's OpenSSH key handling (required at l.19014); also required by bcrypt-pbkdf (l.3636). Dev-tooling HTTP-signature stack of react-scripts only; not shipped to the browser bundle.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Same tweetnacl@0.14.5 library (entry l.19855, via sshpk l.19014 / bcrypt-pbkdf l.3636): its scalarMult/X25519 key-agreement primitive ships in the dev-tooling tree. No first-party call site; not in the browser bundle.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@3.0.1 (entry l.18438): the web3 secret-storage (keystore v3) password KDF. Required by web3-eth-accounts@1.2.11 (l.20672) — the account module of the web3 this app imports — and by ethereumjs-wallet (l.6403) inside the truffle@5.1.39 toolchain. Not exercised by this app (MetaMask holds the keys, no keystore file in repo), but it is the KDF that would encrypt any keystore created with this web3. Changeable by upgrading web3.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge@0.9.0's AES (CBC) — used for self-signed HTTPS dev-cert generation via selfsigned@1.10.7 <- webpack-dev-server <- react-scripts@2.1.3. Dev-server-only; no first-party call site; changeable by upgrading react-scripts.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
